objective_value: <float> Total cost of the production plan, combining setup, startup, inventory holding, and backlogging costs over the planning horizon.
production: <dict, key: '{item}_{machine}_{period}'> Quantity of an item produced on a specific machine in a specific period.
stock: <dict, key: '{item}_{period}'> Inventory of an item held on hand at the end of a specific period.
backlog: <dict, key: '{item}_{period}'> Unfulfilled demand for an item carried as backlog at the end of a specific period.
setup: <dict, key: '{item}_{machine}_{period}'> Whether a machine is set up to produce a given item in a given period (1 = set up).
startup: <dict, key: '{item}_{machine}_{period}'> Whether a machine begins a new setup for a given item in a given period, having not been set up for that item in the previous period (1 = startup occurs).
